# Brunswick Corporation Named to Newsweek’s 2027 America’s Greenest Companies List


[Download as PDF](https://www.brunswick.com/_assets/_5ca55cabffad78ef56d69daf903b97c3/brunswick/news/2026-10-21_Brunswick_Corporation_Named_to_Newsweek_s_2027_1013.pdf) October 21, 2026 1:00pm EDT


**METTAWA, Ill.** (October 21, 2026) **** – Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC), the world’s largest recreational marine technology company, today announced it has been named to Newsweek's 2027 America's Greenest Companies list. Recognized in the Transportation Equipment Manufacturing category, the honor marks another year of recognition for Brunswick's commitment to environmental stewardship, responsible business practices, and creating long-term value through sustainable operations and innovation.


"Being named to Newsweek's America's Greenest Companies list once again reflects the meaningful progress Brunswick continues to make across our sustainability priorities," said Jennifer Koenig, Chief Sustainability Officer, Brunswick Corporation. "From investments in renewable energy and waste reduction initiatives to advancing transparency and environmental performance across our operations, our teams remain focused on creating lasting value for our stakeholders while supporting a more sustainable future."


The annual ranking recognizes 650 U.S. companies demonstrating strong environmental performance, transparency, and measurable progress. More than 6,000 companies were evaluated using publicly available sustainability data and assessed across more than 25 indicators, including greenhouse gas emissions, water use, waste generation, and the strength of environmental commitments and disclosures.


Brunswick continues to advance sustainability initiatives across its global operations, including investments in renewable energy, zero waste-to-landfill programs, and energy-efficient technologies. These efforts are detailed in the Company's latest sustainability report, available[here](https://www.brunswick.com/sustainability) .


To view Newsweek's complete 2027 America's Greenest Companies list, visit:[https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greenest-companies-2027](https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greenest-companies-2027)


*###*


**About Brunswick Corporation:**


Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC) is a global leader in marine recreation, delivering innovation that transforms experiences on the water and beyond. Its technology-driven solutions are informed by deep consumer insights and guided by the belief that “Next Never Rests®.” Brunswick is home to more than 60 industry-leading brands across marine propulsion (including Mercury Marine), parts and accessories (including Attwood), and marine electronics (including Simrad and Lowrance), as well as boat brands including Boston Whaler, Sea Ray, Bayliner, Lund, and Harris. Headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois, Brunswick has approximately 14,000 employees operating in 26 countries. Learn more at Brunswick.com.


Released October 21, 2026
